items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: The last one was Holt. Holton? A brass. A brass. A brass, yeah.

ctx.x: What make did you get next after? Always...

No. The last one was Holt. Holton? A brass. A brass. A brass, yeah. A brass. And then I didn't have that long before I quit. And had a fellow playing the... Used to go through every yard on a circus like that. He was one of those circus trombone players. And I was getting ready to start playing trombone. And on his way through on the circus, I asked him about playing. And he said he had to go to Tulsa Oklahoma to put his shoe up. And when he get there he was riding it. So he did. And I brought him on to New…
I was going to ask some more about the Silverleaf Band. What kind of music they played? Did they play ragtime or was it more blues? Did they use sheet music all the time?
